author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: open heart flame with a clear hole on a wick, a round-shouldered candle and a tapered saucer; reads as a love candle like the reference. The rejected drawing had a heart with a nearly closed hole and a cramped body. Compared three candle widths; kept the narrowest (12) as closest to the reference.
omissions: The wax drip line inside the candle is dropped: the candle body is only 11 tall, so no line fits 8 from both its top and base.
drawing_plan: VRECT_L symmetric about x 24: heart r4 lobes at y 8 with bezier sides to tip y 17; wick to 25; candle x 18..30 with r3 corners to rim 36; saucer rim x 8..40, bezier sides to base y 44 (x 14..34).
lucide_reference: Lucide 'heart' lobe/tip construction on a candle-and-dish body.
